scenes.sub: Unhone bhai ke maathe par tilak lagaya aur aarti utaari.
scenes.animate: the diya flames flicker softly and thin incense smoke curls slowly upward

scenes.prompt: Brother and sister seated together sharing sweets from a thali, Lord Krishna blue-skinned smiling lovingly at Subhadra, lamps and marigold garlands in the background, cosy palace room

scenes.prompt: Lord Krishna blue-skinned raising his palm in blessing over Subhadra, who bows with folded hands, soft golden glow, diyas and rose petals around them, warm loving mood

scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the faces stay still and serene, the diya flames flicker softly, a few petals drift in the background

scenes.tts: तभी से भाई दूज पर बहनें भाई को तिलक लगाती हैं।
